name: patient_has_cardiac_resynchronisation_therapy_indication_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication.

name: patient_has_cardiac_resynchronisation_therapy_indication_now@@according_to_guidelines_and_class_i_iia
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication is according to the guidelines and classified as Class I or Class IIA.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication is both according to the guidelines and classified as Class I or Class IIA.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication is not according to the guidelines and/or not classified as Class I or Class IIA.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current cardiac resynchronisation therapy indication is according to the guidelines and classified as Class I or Class IIA.
